items.name: 10 degree wedge backboard with iPad insertion channel
items.selection_reason: One printed wedge with an open lowered terrace at the marked negative-X end of the rear strip, length 24 mm and depth 7 mm; former enclosed pocket removed. R3 exterior/step rounding, 0.5 mm bottom chamfer. Original iPad cutter retained: 10 mm mouth, 8 mm depth, rearward 20 degrees, no slot edge rounding. Rear support height is locally reduced by the requested terrace.

risks.description: Channel dimensions are editable defaults. Exact iPad/case fit, load capacity and tip resistance require physical verification; no specific iPad model is certified.
